name: Chair Seated Trunk Rotation
steps: Sit tall in an armless chair or stool with your feet flat on the floor and knees hip-width apart.
Cross your arms over your chest or rest one hand on the opposite knee and the other on the back of the chair.
Lengthen your spine tall, then slowly rotate your upper torso to the right as far as comfortable.
Keep your hips square and feet anchored firmly to the floor to isolate the rotation to your spine.
Hold the stretch for 3 to 5 seconds, breathing smoothly.
Slowly unwind back to center, then rotate to the left side.
coaching_cues: Sit tall through your crown before rotating; do not slump or slouch.
Rotate from your ribcage and upper spine rather than torquing your hips.
Do not yank or jerk using chair handles; allow your muscles to gently guide the twist.
